title: Collection, special accounts to be interest bearing.
bodyText: All moneys deposited into the collection account or special account under this part shall be deposited into federally-insured interest-bearing accounts.
bodyHtml: §351-85  Collection, special accounts to be interest bearing.  All moneys deposited into the collection account or special account under this part shall be deposited into federally-insured interest-bearing accounts. [L 1986, c 155, pt of §1]
